caption: The drawing depicts a horse-drawn steam fire engine. On the left, a pale gray horse with a red bridle and harness is shown in motion, pulling a large vehicle. Seated behind the horse on the front part of the fire engine is a person dressed in black clothing and a black hat, holding reins. The fire engine itself is primarily dark blue and features gold decorative elements on the side. The most prominent feature of the engine is a large, cylindrical red steam boiler with black trim, connected by a yellow pipe to a smaller wheel component. The vehicle has large, thin-spoked wheels, also colored dark blue. At the rear of the fire engine stands another person, also dressed in black with a black hat. The background is plain, with a beige or light yellow wash and no additional elements or scenery.
title: Toy Fire Engine
